GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along outpaced Settled Down 11th Inside 7 Lengths within 6 Lengths x 800m within 4 Lengths x 400m off Inside 300 wound up widest x 100m, ran on to the line Sound - # outpaced early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after sustaining an abrasion to the inside of its near-hind leg en route to the course, and was deemed suitable to race. Held up from the 400m until after passing the 300m, where it was shifted out to obtain clear running. Passing the 150m could not be fully tested when being directed outwards to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back to last 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well taking lead in the shadows # ran on from last
Jumped Ok drifted back 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, battled on strong but never threatening # no match 1,2
Bit Slow Out sat 5l off, improved turn, swung Wide Straightening Up 3l off, all clear, 1 length off 200m, half off passing 100m, took over 50m and drew clear # all honours
Jumped Ok sat 4-5l off, eased Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, took over approaching 100m and drew clear # all honours

Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Stayed same until back 1 length @ 900m & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along Two Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured on inside @ 300m & chased fairly without threatening in last 200m. # OK for further.

Tightened @ start. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Stayed Mid Field on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 550m. Pushed along Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & hit top @ 100m. Closed late but just missed. # Ran on well/missed.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was tightened on jumping between rnrs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, ran on well # hit line well

Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed along Five Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Off heels Five Wide @ 300m & pressured Seven Wide @ 250m. Ran on well 9W in last 200m & ran on well. # Gave too much start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding his riding from the 600m, rdr stated that after settling back in the field and when rounding the home turn near the 600m, another rnr improved to his outside and as he felt his mnt was not travelling strongly enough, to avoid covering additional ground he elected to remain behind. He said from the 500m he was able to place his mnt under pressure- whereby the gelding did not give an initial response. He added that near the 300m when the gelding commenced to respond to his riding he was required to shift his mnt out across into clear running whereby finished of well.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to improve 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide @ 400m & chasing Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Worked home OK without threatening in last 200m. # Wide/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with another runner on jumping.
